environment.description: Spring Boot application deployed on EC2 behind a Network Load Balancer (NLB) with no application-layer filtering. SQS queue has SendMessage permission granted to any authenticated AWS principal via resource policy. The /api/v1/enqueue endpoint is publicly accessible. The static AES key and fixed IV allow any attacker who observes one ciphertext to craft arbitrary encrypted messages that decrypt to malicious template expressions containing JavaScript code execution payloads.

config.network: Public subnet, security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 on port 8080
config.iam: EC2 instance role with full SQS access
